title: Adjunction normal form for the source side of integral exchange
statement: Under exactly the prime, normed coefficient, characteristic, finite-type separated scheme and commutative square hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-exchange-equality], the inverse bounded f′ adjunction hom-equivalence sends the source side of the exchange identity to the explicit composite f′_E(α_g(Rf_I K)) ≫ θ_E(T_Y Rf_I K) ≫ g′_E(α_f(Rf_I K) inverse) ≫ g′_E(T_X ε_f(K)). This is a calculation of only one side; it does not assert equality of the source and target sides.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, compatibility with adjunctions and base change

proof.text: Apply the bounded f′ adjunction to the source composite. Expand functoriality, then replace the exchange adjunct by square transport followed by the f counit. Naturality of the square comparison moves the f push comparison past it. The iterated mate/conjugation identity identifies pullback of that push comparison followed by the E counit with the inverse pull comparison followed by scalar extension of the integral counit. These substitutions give exactly the displayed composite.

proof_origin.place: Remark 6.8.15, compatibility with adjunctions and base change; actual ChangeOfCoefficients and derived pullback composition constructions
proof_origin.note: A3: isolated pure pull coherence, a strict part of the original exchange argument.
